title: General Admission Ticket to the Giant House
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
All areas and surfaces are wheelchair accessible
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Step into the Giant’s House in Hollywood! Built to scale for giants, this unique house features rooms that are larger than life, with furniture and fixtures that are fit for a giant’s every need. Wander through the place and admire the intricate details that make this WonderWalk attraction so special.

Have you ever wondered what the world’s most enormous soda can looks like, or whether you could play with a toy built for King Kong? At the Giant’s House, you’ll finally see what it’s like to be 50 feet tall and experience the world from a brand new perspective.
